```python
import pandas as pd

df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Original air date'])
jan_1995 = df[(df['date'].dt.year == 1995) & (df['date'].dt.month == 1)]
oct_1994 = df[(df['date'].dt.year == 1994) & (df['date'].dt.month == 10)]

answer = f"There were more episodes in January 1995 ({len(jan_1995)}) than in October 1994 ({len(oct_1994)})."
print(answer)
```

**Answer:** More — January 1995 had **3** episodes, while October 1994 had **2** episodes.
